name: Growth in Holiness, or the Progress of the Spiritual Life
author: Fr. Frederick William Faber
desc: Faber's treatise of 1854 on the progress of the spiritual life: twenty-seven chapters on the desire of perfection, the mercy of God, liberty of spirit, mortification, prayer, temptations, distractions, lukewarmness, fervor and discretion, drawing on the saints and above all on St. Francis de Sales.
desc_pt: O tratado de Faber (1854) sobre o progresso da vida espiritual: vinte e sete capítulos sobre o desejo da perfeição, a misericórdia de Deus, a liberdade de espírito, a mortificação, a oração, as tentações, as distrações, a tibieza, o fervor e a discrição, apoiados nos santos e, sobretudo, em São Francisco de Sales.
editor: Fr. Frederick William Faber (London: Richardson and Son, 1855)
edition: Growth in Holiness, or the Progress of the Spiritual Life (London: Richardson and Son, 1855), Internet Archive full-text OCR.
srcnote: The dedication, the analytic table of contents and the index are dropped; the preface is kept.
